title: Website Tech Stack Detector
description: Detect technology stacks on public website URLs using owned HTTP fingerprinting. No provider API keys. Each successfully analyzed URL is billed as tech-stack-detected.

websiteUrls.title: Website URLs
websiteUrls.description: Public website URLs or bare domains to fingerprint. Example: https://www.shopify.com or shopify.com. Only http(s) public hosts are accepted — no localhost, private IPs, or credentialed URLs. Prefer full https URLs. Duplicate URLs are deduped. Each successful detection costs $0.01.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (alias)
startUrls.description: Optional alias for websiteUrls using Apify request-list objects. Prefer websiteUrls for agents. Each entry needs a public http(s) url field. Merged and deduped with websiteUrls.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs per run
maxUrls.description: Hard cap on unique URLs processed after dedupe. Defaults to 25. Maximum 50. Lower this to bound spend. Each successful detection costs $0.01 plus platform usage.

includeEvidence.title: Include evidence excerpts
includeEvidence.description: When true, each technology includes a short public-signal evidence excerpt (HTML/header snippet). Defaults to true. Set false for smaller rows when only names and categories are needed.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Per-URL request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout per URL attempt. Defaults to 25. Range 5–60. Does not change pricing. Increase only for slow origins; prefer proxies for blocks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy. Leave off for the default direct HTTPS path. Enable Apify Residential when a target returns 403/429 or Cloudflare challenges. This is not a third-party tech-catalog API.
